sources.title: DUSt3R: Geometric 3D Vision Made Easy (Wang et al.)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: Pointmap regression from uncalibrated/unposed image pairs (no intrinsics, no poses) unifying monocular and binocular reconstruction; global alignment to a common frame for multi-view; cameras/depth/matches recoverable downstream; SoTA monocular/multi-view depth and relative pose; standard Transformer encoder-decoder leveraging pretrained models.
claims.context: Full-paper abstract/contributions/discussion; CVPR 2024. SoTA claims are paper-reported.

claims.text: Paper's own boundary: pointmaps regressed up to unknown scale; generic architecture never explicitly enforces geometric constraints — priors come from geometrically consistent training pointmaps only.
claims.context: Discussion section consumed; recorded as the method's stated limit.
